summary: Single-cell RNA-seq of sorted lung explant cells from IPF, SSc-ILD and normal control donors, with several sorted fractions per donor.

evidence.quote: Tissue was collected from normal control lungs, patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF)
patients with systemic sclerosis associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD)

comparisons.evidence: Tissue was collected from normal control lungs, patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF)
patients with systemic sclerosis associated interstitial lung disease (SSc-ILD)

needs.why: The paper gives the donor-to-fraction coverage and the control lung source in more detail.

abstentions: Control lungs are described as transplant rejection lungs in the source name and as normal controls in the summary; the bundle's control label is used.
Sorted fractions are not present for every donor, so the fraction factor is not balanced across disease groups.
